Home / Services

Landlord services, joined up

From advertising your property to paying your net rent, GETLET coordinates the work of letting so you are not left chasing it yourself.

Property marketing & tenant acquisition

Strong online marketing is at the heart of the GETLET model. Your property is promoted to reach the widest suitable audience of prospective tenants.

  • Rightmove
  • Zoopla
  • Facebook
  • Instagram
  • TikTok

Referencing, deposit protection and tenancy agreements are covered in your written management agreement.

What this covers

  • Advertising on property portals and social media
  • Enquiries from prospective tenants answered and qualified
  • Viewings arranged
  • Finding a suitable tenant for your property

What tenants get

  • A clear route to report a repair
  • One point of contact for the property
  • Issues logged, so nothing relies on memory

Tenant management

Once a tenant moves in, GETLET is the tenant's contact for rent queries and maintenance. How much of that reaches you depends on your plan: in Fully Managed, tenant issues are handled end to end; in Limited Management, we report the issue, get your approval, then dispatch.

Compare the two plans

Rent collection

Rent is paid into a PayProp-linked account. When it arrives, recorded invoices and expenses are deducted automatically and the remaining balance is paid to you.

How rent and statements work

Landlord reporting & expense management

Every piece of work done on your property is entered as an invoice, so each deduction can be traced back to the work behind it. That creates an audit trail you can read and check.

Property maintenance, repairs & contractor coordination

Plumbing, heating, electrical and general repairs are carried out by a pre-vetted contractor network. GETLET coordinates the visit and records the invoice.

Trades covered: Plumbing, heating, electrical and general repairs.

How repairs work

Gas & electrical certification coordination

GETLET arranges gas and electrical certificates through specialist partner agencies. GETLET does not carry out certified work itself.

Important: arranging a certificate does not remove the landlord's legal duty. You remain responsible for making sure your property meets the current requirements.

Gas and electrical certificates are arranged through specialist partner agencies. See our England compliance guidance.

Being clear about limits

What is not covered, and what is agreed in writing

Not part of GETLET's service

  • Tax advice (speak to a qualified accountant)
  • Legal advice (speak to a solicitor)
  • Carrying out certified gas or electrical work ourselves
  • A landlord login or online financial dashboard

Agreed in writing with each landlord

  • Fees and charges, itemised in your written quotation
  • Tenant referencing
  • Deposit protection
  • Tenancy agreements
  • Out-of-hours handling
